mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through lower cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (low rate threshold), or correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending power and corporate revenue growth, which drives negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1) combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a healthy economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 20-day returns through robust corporate earnings and stable consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL 12m change < 3.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when both GDPC1 growth > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL 12m change < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle expansion (GDP growth > 2.0% and inflation > 3.0% for two consecutive quarters) triggers anticipated monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL 12m change > 3.0% for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when the late-cycle regime (GDPC1 > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% for two quarters) is active.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate profitability and generating negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A recent federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 2.5% within the last month signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and generating negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns through heightened volatility.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) above 380,000 million dollars indicates robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through elevated corporate revenue growth and profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 380,000.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate decline (UNRATE) signal strong labor market conditions, increasing consumer confidence and spending, which generates positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp.
